item.description:
First public release of Curstyle, a macOS cursor theme changer.
**Get themes** - Import Windows cursor themes (`.cur` / `.ani`), Mousecape `.cape` files, and GIFs. - Long animations are resampled to 24 frames automatically.
**Make them yours** - Preview every cursor, animated, in light and dark mode. - Edit hotspots and animation speed, replace any cursor with a GIF or PNG, and scale the whole theme from 0.1x to 5x.
**Use them** - Apply a theme, or go back to the macOS defaults, from the app or the menu bar. - Your theme is reapplied after login, restart, wake, and pointer setting changes. - If a theme does not show up, built-in diagnostics can export a report.
**Also** - Updates arrive in-app through Sparkle. - English and Japanese.
Apple Silicon only, tested on macOS 27.2. Curstyle is not notarized: on first launch, choose **Open Anyway** in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
